lead.question: 一对夫妇走进巴尔干半岛的偏僻山村，为何遇上一片令人毛骨悚然的沉默？
lead.warmup: 人们总以为偏远村庄的村民热情好客，作者与妻子却在巴尔干半岛的旅途中发现并非如此。他们离开熙攘的小镇，沿小路穿过树林、渡过深溪，来到一座挂在山坡上的小村。村庄空寂无人，只有一只被拴住的黑山羊。正当他们在破篱笆边野餐时，沉默的人群悄悄围了上来。
goals: 掌握 inaccessible to、hospitable、hostile、straggling、dilapidated、forbidding 等描写偏远村庄的词汇。
读懂 The village seemed deserted, the only sign of life being... 这类独立主格结构。
复习被动语态（were built of、were surrounded by、could be heard）以及定语从句和分词短语作定语。
体会全文如何用“沉默”层层渲染紧张气氛，并能依据线索复述故事梗概。
lead.summary: 全文以“沉默”为线索：先写偏僻之地未必好客，再写作者夫妇为躲避游客而深入乡野，历经小路、密林、深溪与渡船，抵达一座灰土坯砌成、看似无人居住的山村。孩子们无声围观、村民从门窗后注视、全村没有一丝声响，最终让他们意识到自己是不受欢迎的不速之客，于是匆匆离去。
lead.tips: 易错提醒：deserted 是形容词“空无一人的”，别与 dessert（甜点）混淆；the only sign of life being... 是独立主格结构，不能写成 is。

questions.zh: 这个村庄为什么一片寂静？
questions.a: Because the villagers were hostile to the strangers: they watched the couple in complete silence and no one made a sound, so the couple realised they were unwelcome visitors and left.
questions.aZh: 因为村民对外来者怀有敌意：他们一声不响地注视着这对夫妇，全村听不到一点声音，夫妇俩于是意识到自己不受欢迎，便离开了。
questions.hint: 答案见 The most frightening thing of all was that not a sound could be heard. 与 There was no doubt that we were unwelcome visitors.

questions.q: What did the writer and his wife do on the last day of their stay in the small town?
questions.zh: 在小镇逗留的最后一天，作者夫妇做了什么？
questions.a: They took a path out of the town, crossed a few fields, tramped through a dense wood and came to a deep stream, where a boatman ferried them across to a tiny village.
questions.aZh: 他们沿一条出镇的小路穿过几片田地，在密林里跋涉了两个多小时来到一条深溪，由船夫摆渡过溪，到达一个小村庄。
questions.hint: 见 so we decided to spend our last day exploring the countryside 一直到船夫摆渡那几段。

questions.q: What was the only sign of life in the village?
questions.zh: 村里唯一的生命迹象是什么？
questions.a: An ugly-looking black goat on a short length of rope tied to a tree in a field nearby.
questions.aZh: 附近田里一只面目可憎的黑山羊，被一截短绳拴在一棵树上。
questions.hint: 见 The village seemed deserted, the only sign of life being... 一句。

questions.q: How did the children behave when the couple offered them food and spoke to them kindly?
questions.zh: 作者夫妇给孩子们食物、客气地同他们交谈时，孩子们有什么反应？
questions.a: They remained motionless; they just looked at the couple silently as they ate.
questions.aZh: 他们一动不动，只是默不作声地看着夫妇俩吃饭。
questions.hint: 见 We offered them food and spoke to them kindly, but they remained motionless.

questions.q: What does the writer mean by We needed no further warning?
questions.zh: 作者说“我们不需要进一步的警告了”是什么意思？
questions.a: The silent, glaring villagers were themselves the warning: the couple understood at once that they were unwelcome, so they turned back and hurried towards the stream.
questions.aZh: 沉默围观、怒目而视的村民本身就是警告：夫妇俩立刻明白自己不受欢迎，于是转身加快脚步奔向溪边。
questions.hint: 结合上句 There was no doubt that we were unwelcome visitors. 体会。

exercises.q: 汉译英：在这个旅游频繁的世界上，仍有成千上万个游人足迹未至的地方。
exercises.a: In this much-travelled world, there are still thousands of places which are inaccessible to tourists.

exercises.q: 汉译英：村里似乎无人居住，唯一的生命迹象是附近田里一只面目可憎的黑山羊，用一截短绳拴在一棵树上。
exercises.a: The village seemed deserted, the only sign of life being an ugly-looking black goat on a short length of rope tied to a tree in a field nearby.

exercises.q: 用所给词的正确形式填空：The village seemed ______ (desert), the only sign of life ______ (be) an ugly-looking black goat.
exercises.note: seem后接形容词；独立主格用being。

exercises.q: 改为被动语态：They built all the houses of grey mud bricks.
exercises.a: All the houses were built of grey mud bricks.
exercises.note: 一般过去时被动；be built of。

exercises.q: 改错：Looking up I saw that we surrounded by children in rags who were looking at us silently.
exercises.a: Looking up I saw that we were surrounded by children in rags who were looking at us silently.

exercises.q: 合并句子（用分词或定语从句）：The path led to a tiny village. It was perched on the steep sides of a mountain.
exercises.a: The path led to a tiny village perched on the steep sides of a mountain.
exercises.note: 过去分词短语作后置定语。

exercises.q: 汉译英：最令人害怕的是到处没有一点声音。
exercises.a: The most frightening thing of all was that not a sound could be heard.
exercises.note: 被动语态；not a sound作主语。

quiz.q: 那座村庄为什么一片沉默？
options: All the villagers had been evacuated before the couple arrived.
The villagers watched the strangers in silence and made no sound at all.
The children were playing a game and had been told not to speak.
The couple were too frightened to speak to anybody.
quiz.note: no sound could be heard，沉默即敌意。

quiz.q: 作者夫妇为什么在最后一天离开小镇去乡间？
options: They wanted to visit more old churches in the vicinity.
They had run out of food and went to buy some in the village.
Several busloads of tourists arrived and it was more than they could bear.
The boatman had invited them to a picnic by the stream.
quiz.note: 游客descended on the town，人多得难以忍受。

quiz.q: The village seemed deserted 中 deserted 最接近的意思是？
options: crowded with noisy visitors
having no people living in it
destroyed by heavy rain
hidden behind a dense wood

quiz.q: 关于那座村庄，下面哪一句符合课文？
options: The houses were built of grey mud bricks and the unmade road straggled along.
The village stood on the flat bank of a deep stream.
The houses were made of stone and contained beautiful frescoes.
The village was famous for its friendly and hospitable inhabitants.

quiz.q: 作者起初怎样解释孩子们的一言不发？
options: He believed they were hungry and wanted his sardines.
He thought they were simply shy of strangers.
He was sure they had come to warn him of danger.
He thought they were the boatman's own children.
quiz.note: I concluded that they were simply shy of strangers.

quiz.q: 夫妇俩走在村里的大街上时，出现了什么情形？
options: The villagers came out and shouted angrily at them.
The village emptied and everybody hid indoors.
Faces appeared at windows, men glared and old women peered, all in silence.
The children led them politely to the boatman's house.
quiz.note: 村庄活跃起来，却仍无一丝声响。
